newsitem.title: UK: Pru recovers after DKB upgrades to "add".
newsitem.headline: Pru recovers after DKB upgrades to "add".

text.p: Shares in British insurer Prudential Corp recovered from an opening loss on Wednesday after analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson upgraded the stock to "add" from "hold".
The shares rose 3-1/2p to 613-1/2p in trade of 1.3 million by 0835 GMT after earlier slipping as low as 605p.
Analysts at Kleinwort Benson upgraded the stock but left earnings forecasts unchanged after the company revealed first-half profits in line with expectations.
Pre-tax operating profit rose to 442 million stg from 421 million a year ago, matching the consensus forecast.
